text:
Hello everyone, this is for people who had to appeal. My partner was asked to deposit 30,000 NIS, and we appealed. Please, I'd like to know from people who had similar case, (who had to appeal)
How long did it take to get response from Misrad hapnim?
Did it take months to get response 
We waited 11 months until they arrived at the decision for us to pay for 30,000 shekels.?
